title: 第15章 你没资格进去第16章 我只相信陈凡
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
“你怎么会有请柬的？这不可能啊！”
黄超难以置信地看着陈凡手中的请帖说道。
“你这个劳改犯怎么可能得到的魏老的邀请？这一定不是真的！
对，一定是假的！”
徐欣指着请柬，肯定地说道。
保安也不信陈凡能得到魏秋的邀请，他谨慎地检查了一下，却没想到竟然是真的。
“怎么样？请柬有问题吗？”
陈凡嘴角挂着戏谑地笑容问道。
“没…没问题。”
保安大脑一片空白，机械式地说道。
“怎么可能是真的？不可能！
绝不可能！
连我们都收不到请柬，他一个劳改犯怎么可能收得到！
？”
黄超无法接受这样的事实，一不留神还把实话说了出来。
“你们没有请柬？”
保安眉头一皱，看向黄超的目光立刻变得不善起来。
黄超知道自己说漏了嘴，赶紧解释道：“我是韩氏集团在M国一家分公司的总经理，今天是韩少邀请我来的。”
他并没有完全说真话，其实是黄超软磨硬泡求着韩根硕让自己来这里的。
黄超虽然有幸得到了韩家的信任，但他这么多年在国外也待腻了，很想找机会回来发展。

所以，这一次魏秋举办的盛会对于黄超而言，是一个难能可贵的机会。
“这次魏老举办的盛会都是韩少一手操办的，他就请了我们两个来，没什么问题吧？”
徐欣一脸傲娇地说道。
“理论上应该是可以，但我还是要确认一下，你们要不给韩少打个电话吧。”
保安提议道。
“这个当然没问题。”
黄超马上拨通了韩根硕的电话，对方说正在忙让他们先等一下，等下就出来接两人。
黄超和徐欣得到答复，这才算是吃了定心丸。
两人看着陈凡手中的请柬，依然不信是真的，恰在这时，一名带着圆顶帽的老人带着几个手下步履匆匆来到门口，像是有什么急事要办。
黄超和徐欣一眼就认出了老者正是魏秋的亲信李锦，每次魏秋在公开场合露面，李锦都始终跟在身边。
据说李锦既是魏秋的管家，又是他的贴身保镖，深得对方信赖。
看到李锦，黄超灵机一动立刻上前说道：“李总管您好，很高兴见到您。”
“你是谁？有事吗？”
李锦微微皱眉，目光中带着厌恶，显然并不想搭理对方。
“自我介绍一下，我叫黄超，是韩少叫我来的。”
黄超说道。
“哦，那你有什么事去找韩根硕吧，我赶时间去迎接小少爷。”
李锦说完就要离开。
content_en:
"How come you have an invitation? This is impossible!"
Huang Chao looked at the invitation in Chen Fan's hand in disbelief and said.
"How could you, a reform-through-labor prisoner, get Mr. Wei's invitation? This must not be true!
Yes, it must be fake! "
Xu Xin pointed at the invitation and said affirmatively.
The security guard didn't believe that Chen Fan could get Wei Qiu's invitation. He checked carefully, but he didn't expect that it was true.
"How's it going? Is there something wrong with the invitation?"
Chen Fan asked with a joking smile on his lips.
"No...no problem."
The security guard's mind went blank and he said mechanically.
"How could it be true? Impossible!
Absolutely impossible!
Even we couldn't receive the invitation, how could he, a prisoner in labor camp, receive it!
? "
Huang Chao couldn't accept this fact and accidentally told the truth.
"You don't have an invitation?"
The security guard frowned, and his look at Huang Chao immediately turned unkind.
Huang Chao knew that he had spilled the beans and quickly explained: "I am the general manager of a branch of the Han Group in country M. Mr. Han invited me here today."
He didn't tell the complete truth. In fact, it was Huang Chao who begged Han Geun Suk to let him come here.
Although Huang Chao was fortunate enough to gain the trust of the Han family, he was tired of staying abroad for so many years and wanted to find opportunities to come back and develop.
Therefore, this grand event held by Wei Qiu is a rare opportunity for Huang Chao.
"This grand gathering organized by Mr. Wei was all organized by Young Master Han. He invited the two of us to come. Is there no problem?"
Xu Xin said with a proud look.
"Theoretically it should be possible, but I still want to confirm. Why don't you give Mr. Han a call."
The security guard suggested.
"Of course that's no problem."
Huang Chao immediately dialed Han Genshuo's number. The other party said that he was busy and asked them to wait for a while, and he would come out to pick them up later.
Huang Chao and Xu Xin received the answer, which was reassurance.
The two of them looked at the invitation in Chen Fan's hand, still not believing it to be true. At this moment, an old man wearing a round hat and several of his men hurried to the door, as if there was something urgent to do.
Huang Chao and Xu Xin recognized the old man at a glance as Wei Qiu's confidant Li Jin. Every time Wei Qiu appeared in public, Li Jin always followed him.
It is said that Li Jin was both Wei Qiu's housekeeper and his personal bodyguard, and was deeply trusted by him.
Seeing Li Jin, Huang Chao had an idea and immediately stepped forward and said, "Hello, Mr. Li, it's nice to meet you."
"Who are you? Is something wrong?"
Li Jin frowned slightly, with disgust in his eyes, obviously not wanting to talk to him.
"Let me introduce myself. My name is Huang Chao. Young Master Han asked me to come."
Huang Chao said.
"Oh, if you have anything to do, go to Han Genshuo. I'm in a hurry to greet the young master."
After Li Jin finished speaking, he was about to leave.
